<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/financing/v3/installment-programs/offers"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a list of available installment programs for the given price, down payment, product sets, and customer types.

When a customer wants to pay for a purchase by a loan and you want to show them an offer of available installment programs, use `/financing/v3/installment-programs/offers` resource with properly filled request that contains at least following data:
- Product set codes (you should know the proper product set codes from Home Credit's sales representative or other similar source)
- Price of customer's purchase
- Client types (in dependency on your business)
- Down payment (optional, default is 0)

If the request was successfully processed, you receive HTTP status code 200 and array of objects of available installment programs with at least following information in the response:
- Installment program (array)
  - Installment program product code
  - Customer types that can use the calculated offer
  - Installment program type (in case of only one installment program offer in response it is of type `FAVOURITE`)
  - Installment amount
  - Number of installments
